patch.value: Checkout release alert script from the default branch

Greptile found on pm-beads PR #80 that workflow_dispatch from a divergent or older ref can make the alert job check out that rejected ref, where scripts/alert-on-release-failure.sh may not exist. Harden the merged pm-brief reference workflow so the nonblocking alert always executes the trusted script from the repository default branch.

The alert checkout explicitly uses github.event.repository.default_branch; The YAML verifier and runtime tests fail if the trusted ref wiring is removed; Full release:check, packed acceptance, coverage, audit, PM validation, and reconciliation pass
GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch on a divergent ref
Dispatch .github/workflows/release.yml from a ref predating the tracked alert script, then force the release job to fail; the alert checkout follows the event ref and cannot invoke the script.
The alert job checks out github.event.repository.default_branch before invoking the tracked alert script, preserving stable deduplication and nonblocking behavior.
The checkout inherits the workflow event ref, so an older manual-dispatch ref can omit the tracked alert script.
